title: 5.6.1 Reading: A sound on a hit
description: loadSound() downloads a sound once, in setup(); .play() plays one copy and .volume sets how loud. The chime goes where the score goes, inside the edge check, so a hit gives one ding and not a buzz. Most browsers stay silent until the first click or key press on the game. Read before 5.6.3 Lab: A chime on every bumper hit.
unit: 5.6 Pinball: a sound on a hit
